title: FreezeManifest
description: Shipping container written by the freeze step: the dates the demo-wide statement needs on every screen ('produced offline and frozen on ...'), independent of whichever content module a screen loads. It is the only data module loaded at start-up; if it fails, the application shows G-E1 rather than an undated statement. Not rendered as an element of its own. Shipped in data/freeze.js.

pipelineRunOn.description: The date the offline runtime pipeline ran.

modules.description: Every data module the freeze step wrote, as repository-relative paths. Lets the M1 test detect a hand-added or missing module.
